answers.reason: Quote exact; 'can help' is optional, the stable-materials condition is in the statement, and OSD fits the materials named.
Quote exact; designing the assessment so held materials are suitable without formal stability studies is stated whole; 'should' = recommended.
Quote exact; the risk assessment 'may include' sampling and testing at the stage it sets is kept at optional strength.
Quote exact; stability studies under an approved protocol for unstable or over-held materials are stated with both conditions.
Quote exact; evaluating the materials up to their use in the hold-time stability studies is captured at recommended strength.
Quote exact; long-term monitoring of finished batches made with held materials is captured at recommended strength.
Quote exact; the 'latter case' conditions and the 'until stability data' condition are kept, with expiry dated from the intermediate's manufacture/release.
Quote exact; highly purified, well characterized, accurately weighable calibration standards = recommended, stated whole.
Quote exact; standards 'can be' compendial or non-compendial with the examples given; optional.
Quote exact; purification and characterization by validated processes and methods for supplier or in-house standards = recommended.
Quote exact; 'generally should be avoided' with the reason about excipients is captured with its qualifier.
Quote exact; 'FDA expects' = recommended; qualified primary or secondary standards plus needed materials are captured.
Quote exact; qualifying each new batch of reference material against the primary standard = recommended.
Quote exact; unqualified finished dosage forms or APIs not to be used for system suitability; 'should not' = recommended.
Quote exact; the same-batch exclusion for qualified standards is stated with its condition.
Quote exact; written procedures 'must be established and followed' (211.160, 211.194, laboratory) is mandatory.
Quote exact; all data including errors and failing, passing and suspect data must be in CGMP records and reviewed; mandatory.
Quote exact and mandatory, but the statement narrows 'Records' to laboratory records, while the text (citing 211.188 batch records among others) covers records generally.
Quote exact; the appropriate practice of injecting a standard only to establish system fitness is stated as recommended.
Quote exact; all data from product sample analysis 'must be retained and reviewed' is mandatory and stated whole.
Quote exact; promptly correcting the fundamental lab problems that uncertainty may suggest is captured with its condition.
Quote exact; full description in the validation package and definition in an approved procedure, when justified, are both captured.

Quote exact; consistent, unambiguous injection nomenclature = recommended.
Quote exact; maintaining and reviewing all column conditioning data including audit trails = recommended.
Quote exact; trial injections, including disguised as column conditioning, are a violative practice, stated as a prohibition.
Quote exact; using actual samples in test, prep or equilibration runs to test into compliance is a violative practice, stated whole.
